module.title: Shared Identifiers, Contacts, Addresses and Files
module.business_purpose: Reusable official identifiers, contact channels, international addresses and a storage-provider-neutral file catalog. Medical files are logical records with immutable content versions and explicit links to patients, reports, notes, studies, posts or financial records.
